facts.fact: PAREC, under UNESCO and a September 2022 agreement with the Government of Cameroon, handed the National Institute of Statistics a server, laptops, desktops and a SQL-server licence on 4 June 2024 to operationalize the integrated sectoral education management information system platform, with a dedicated EMIS internet line still to be provided.
facts.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS) integrated sectoral platform
